pregame.pressurePoint: San Diego State run game vs Oregon State run defense. Oregon State is No. 59 of 138 against the run (40%). San Diego State ranks No. 130 in rush success rate (35%). A clear edge, the kind that shapes a game plan. San Diego State will find the run hard going. Expect more second-and-long than usual. Watch San Diego State's yards per carry through the first quarter. Under 3 and the game plan has to change.

Oregon State is No. 28 of 138 at limiting explosive passes (1.40). San Diego State ranks No. 73 in pass explosiveness (1.54). A real edge, not a lock. Oregon State keeps the lid on. San Diego State should expect to drive the long way.
